snippet.title: ANATINE | Steam PC | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Anatine is a pixelated Metroidvania game that contains organic musical elements. Play the flute to interact with the environment or unleash powerful magic! In the dangerous world of Avenis, battle against the Eidolons and confront powerful enemies to uncover the many secrets of this lost world.
